distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 214.5745 +/- 0.0476 mas (same row, RUWE 1.61): 4.66 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.14 solar radii from Morin et al., arXiv:1005.5552, Table 1: radius 0.14 solar radii (theoretical radius) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1005.5552): 97,398 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
